faqs.question: Which item leads browser versions (tablet) in Germany?

faqs.answer: Figures are market share of tracked page views / usage from the cited source for October 2026. They are not invented estimates.

faqs.question: What are the top three for browser versions (tablet) in Germany?
faqs.answer: Chrome for Android (46.74%), Safari iPad (20.77%), Chrome iPad (14.71%) in October 2026.
